recipes.name: Jicama French Fries
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Peel skin from jicama
3. Cut jicama in to french fry shape
4.Add jicama to boiling water for 10 minutes.
5. Add all spices and oil to bowl and mix. 
6. Drain Jicama and dry off with towel. 
7. Mix jicama with spices and oil and toss together.
8. Transfer to a baking tray and bake for 40 minutes, flipping as needed.
9. Let cool down, serve and enjoy!

recipes.name: Pollo Asado
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large bowl, whisk together orange juice, lime juice, garlic (minced), olive oil, soy sauce, and all other spices.
2. Add chicken thighs and toss to coat. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours, or overnight. 
3. preheat grill to medium high. Grill until cooked
4. Let rest for a few minutes, slice or serve whole. Add Cilantro and lime wedges for garnish.
Great for Burritos, Tacos, Salads, bowls, or serve with rice and beans!

recipes.name: Shrimp Ceviche
recipes.instructions:
1. Dice all vegetables (onions and cilantro, finely chopped)
2. Cut Shrimp into smaller pieces
3. Add all diced veggies and shrimp into a bowl, and pour lime juice all over.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Chill for 5-10 minutes.
6. Serve with tostadas and enjoy

recipes.instructions: Serve on a bed of lettuce, or in a sandwich, or with crackers.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Mashed Potatoes
recipes.instructions:
1. Cut cauliflower into florets and boil for 10 minutes or until tender.
2. Drain well, then add cauliflower, garlic, grated parmesan to a food processor. 
3. Blend until smooth creamy, season salt & pepper.
4. Optional, Garnish with fresh minced Parlsey, and a pinch of paprika.

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Zucchini Boats
recipes.instructions:
1. Boil chicken, flavor water with salt, and optionally a pinch of Chicken Buillion. 
2. Make Garlic Butter: Mix melted butter and minced garlic.
3. Cut the zucchini in half long ways, and scoop out the middle to make the boats. 
4. Shred cooked chicken, place in zucchini boat. 
5. Drizzle with garlic butter, sprinkle parmesan cheese evenly over each boat. 
6. Bake @ 350 for 18-22 minutes or until zucchini is tender and chees is golden and bubbly.  

(Variations) Add Italian seasoning, red pepper flakes, or paprika for extra flavor
Use Rotisserie Chicken as a quick shortcut
Top with parsley or extra parmesan.

recipes.name: Honey Lime Chicken & Avacado Rice Stack
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk together honey, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, salt and pepper. Marinate chicken in mixture for at least 30 minutes.
2. Cook Rice and let it cool.
3. Dice avocado into small bite-sized pieces.
4. Grill or pan-fry chicken until cooked through.
5.  Mix Rice with avocado, sour cream, and cilantro. 
6. Stack rice on a plate, top with sliced chicken. Add extra lime juice, optional.
